profiles.notes: 2027 international school-leaver entry. Score sets are linked to programmes with the same published values.

requirements.label: IB Admissions Score conversion
requirements.details: UQ uses the converted IB Admissions Score (IBAS) for university entry, and can translate it to an ATAR-like Combined Rank. Fractional programme scores in the 2027 matrix are preserved as converted admission scores.

source.title: UQ International Baccalaureate and ATAR, IBAS calculation

requirements.label: US secondary credential and AP, SAT or ACT evidence
requirements.details: Provide an accepted secondary completion credential. For AP, provide the College Board results and count two to four tests. Use the best four results when more than four are presented. UQ also lists separate SAT and ACT routes.

source.title: UQ USA high school qualifications, standardized tests and AP aggregate

requirements.label: Secondary completion and subject prerequisites
requirements.details: Complete Queensland Year 12 or an accepted equivalent. Meet the programme’s academic score, required subjects, English proficiency and any additional programme selection.

source.title: UQ undergraduate entry requirements, qualification and prerequisites

requirements.label: Standard undergraduate English proficiency
requirements.details: The guide’s standard IELTS route is 6.5 overall and 6.0 in every band. Recognised academic evidence or equivalent tests may also be accepted. Some programmes set higher scores.

source.title: UQ 2027 international minimum entry scores, PDF page 2

requirements.label: International undergraduate application route
requirements.details: International applicants with senior schooling outside Australia generally apply directly or through an approved agent. Applicants currently taking Australian Year 12 or completing IB in Australia typically apply through QTAC. Check the programme’s exceptions.

source.title: UQ international undergraduate application routes
